title: Data Architect | AI & Data Engineering
description:
Data Architect | AI & Data Engineering

£70,000 - £90,000 | UK Hybrid | Permanent


Ncounter is working with a growing technology consultancy specialising in data engineering, artificial intelligence and the development of intelligent software solutions. With increasing demand for its expertise across complex public sector and enterprise environments, the business is looking to appoint an experienced Data Architect.

This is an opportunity to work alongside talented engineers, data scientists and technical consultants, helping organisations turn fragmented, complex data into reliable foundations for modern analytics, machine learning and AI applications.

The role combines architecture, technical consulting and practical delivery, with the opportunity to influence how data platforms are designed, developed and adopted across a range of challenging projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing scalable data architectures supporting analytics, AI and machine learning workloads
  • Developing data models, integration patterns and data processing approaches
  • Working with engineering teams to design robust data pipelines and modern data platforms
  • Advising customers on data strategy, architecture and technology selection
  • Establishing appropriate data governance, quality and security principles
  • Supporting the integration of structured and unstructured data into AI-enabled applications
  • Translating complex business requirements into practical technical solutions


What we're looking for:

  • Strong experience in Data Architecture, ideally within consulting or complex delivery environments
  • Good understanding of cloud data platforms, preferably AWS or Azure
  • Experience with data modelling, ETL/ELT, data pipelines and modern data engineering practices
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL and distributed data processing technologies
  • An understanding of how data architecture supports machine learning, generative AI and wider AI applications
  • Confidence engaging technical and non-technical stakeholders

Experience delivering solutions within secure or regulated environments would be advantageous. Candidates should hold or be eligible for UK Security Clearance.

This opportunity offers genuine technical variety, exposure to emerging AI technologies and the chance to influence meaningful projects from their earliest stages.

If you're a Data Architect looking to combine strong technical foundations with innovative, AI-focused delivery, contact Ncounter for a confidential discussion.
